verdict.rationale: Barge-in handling is a fair axis for a voice AI agent platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents interruption detection, stopping TTS playback, updating context, or recovering the turn. The 'switches mid-call' evidence concerns language switching, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the agent to handle interruptions (barge-in) gracefully — stopping speech, updating context, and recovering the turn
